name: dailies
description: Gate an AI change on declared evidence before it advances. The release-gate skill teaches an agent to create a digest-pinned starter corpus with dailies init, explain the verified, deterministic, and self-reported trust classes, run the release evaluation, and read report.md and exit codes 0, 1, and 2 as promote, block, or inconclusive. Inconclusive means evidence was missing or untrusted and is left for a human to resolve.
